This application requires an internet connection and access to the list of installed applications to provide convenient control-related services, including flashlight, temporarily keeping the screen on, switching to floating window mode, opening new applications, and music applications. During usage, it needs to access location information, SMS data, schedule data, call logs, and the device unique identifier (IMEI) to provide services such as reminding you to pick up parcels, offering smart travel based on location and SMS parsing, real-time schedule reminders, intelligent reminders for missed calls, and establishing a secure communication channel. The collection and use of the aforementioned personal information are triggered only when using specific business functions. \n\nPlease read the %1$s to learn more about how we handle your personal information and read the %2$s to understand your rights and obligations.
